title: Use Vitest for unit testing
yStatement: In the context of a new TypeScript and Vite monorepo, facing a need for fast feedback, I decided to use Vitest to achieve fast test runs, accepting a smaller plugin ecosystem.
context: The repository uses Vite for its build pipeline.
The team needs fast local test feedback.
decision: Use Vitest because it integrates with the existing Vite pipeline and provides fast feedback.
consequences: Some Jest-only plugins may require alternatives.
